purpose: Curator proposal: kind A (carved wooden printing blocks) for the three study traditions, one tool photograph per tradition, each attached to a tool concept in the materials-tools section. Not craft facts; nothing here is published until curators accept it, and ingest skips every entry whose status is not "proposed". Evidence: the process-photo proposal (DR-057), docs/research/sahapedia-image-permission-reply.md and the Flickr records. Never written into content/traditions/*.json.

entryFormat.id: unique id; the Flickr ids match the reserve entries of the same photograph in media-proposals.json
entryFormat.status: held | proposed | rejected; held = rights and evidence in place for the slot but a named condition is still open (heldUntil); proposed = every condition met (conditionsMet says how); only proposed is ingested
entryFormat.source: vam | rick-bradley | sahapedia | eric-parker | pari: whose credit, licence and conditions scripts/content/ingest-study-photos.ts applies (PHOTO_SOURCES)
entryFormat.photographer: the name the credit carries; required by every source except the V&A; a placeholder such as [Photographer's Name] is refused
entryFormat.recordTitle: optional; the record's own title, quoted in a Flickr credit
entryFormat.kind: the balanced kind; the derivative is scripts/content/study-photos/<tradition>-<kind>-768.jpg
entryFormat.claimIds: the anchor claim first (the figure shows after it)
entryFormat.caption: the record's own wording only while the anchor concept is under review (DR-020); square brackets mark the project's inference; no new craft fact
entryFormat.altText: what is visible, 8 to 30 words, not the caption
entryFormat.notes: a note starting with crop, edit or alter is credited (cropped) on the Flickr and V&A sources and refused on Sahapedia and PARI
entryFormat.heldUntil: the open conditions; when every one is met, a curator sets status to proposed
entryFormat.conditionsMet: how each heldUntil condition was met when the status changed to proposed

balanceNote: The three are proposed together or not at all (DR-020 balance rule: a kind missing for any tradition is dropped for all three). All three are colour still-life photographs of blocks with no people.
